THE SHANGHAI TIMES, TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 21, 1933
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. of S. PUBLICITY
No. D - 471
Date 21 // 1933

ECHO OF LYTTON'S
VISIT TO EAST

Korean Terrorist Gets
Sentence Of Life
Imprisonment

DAIREN, Nov. 20.—Liu So-kon,
Korean terrorist from Shanghai,
who, in May of last year, unsuc-
cessfully plotted to kill Lord Lyt-
ton and other commissioners of
the League of Nations Committee
of Inquiry on Manchuria, at the
Dairen Railway Station, has decid-
ed to accept the verdict of the
Dairen District Court.
Liu was found guilty and sen-
tenced to life imprisonment.
Sai Ko-shoku, Liu's accomplice,
also found guilty and sentenced
to 10 years in prison, has appeal-
ed, however. He claims that he
had no intention of participating
in the plot.—Reuter.

S2 11/25
21/11/33.

《字林西报》，1933年11月21日，星期二
上海工部局
秘书处宣传科
编号 D - 471
日期 1933年11月21日

李顿爵士访问东方之反响

朝鲜恐怖分子被判无期徒刑

大连，11月20日电。——来自上海的朝鲜恐怖分子刘索坤（Liu So-kon，音译），去年五月曾在大连火车站策划暗杀国际联盟满洲调查团团长李顿勋爵及其他委员，但未得逞。此人已决定接受大连地方法院的判决。
刘犯被裁定有罪，判处无期徒刑。
刘的同谋斋藤孝作（Sai Ko-shoku，音译）亦被裁定有罪，判处有期徒刑十年，但他已提出上诉。他声称自己无意参与该阴谋。——路透社。

S2 11/25
1933年11月21日。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. No. D/S/2/188/33
Special Branch
REPORT Date May 12, 1933.
Subject (in full) Assassination plot
Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by O.Blu. D.
In accordance with the instructions of the Officer i/c
Special Branch, I have to report that the information contained
in the attached cutting from the "Shanghai Times" dated May 8,
1933, regarding the plot by local Korean malcontents to assassinate
leading Manchukuo and Japanese officials in Manchuria is without
foundation.
The local Japanese Consular Police have so far received
no information from the Dairen Police concerning the arrest of
any radical elements who proceeded there from Shanghai.
Following the arrest of three Korean anarchists by the Municipal
Police on March 17, 1933, all known Korean terrorists have fled
to parts unknown and consequently their activities in regard to
Shanghai are practically at a standstill.
It is interesting to note the following extract from the
statement made by Haku Kyu Ha, 2nd accused in the case against
the three Korean anarchists who were arrested on March 17, 1933,
to an officer of the local Japanese Consular Police:-
"Members of the Black Terrorist Party have agreed upon to
seize every opportunity in carrying out their work of destruction.
The attempted assassination of the Japanese Minister was arranged
by ourselves and without the instigation of others. If we had
sufficient funds to go abroad more serious offences might have
been committed. We are sorry for not being able to carry them
out for lack of funds. We chose Mr. Ariyoshi, Japanese Minister
to China, as our victim, because we can carry out the plot with
less expense owing to his presence in Shanghai. As we have no
ill feeling against the Minister personally, we regret to
assassinate him and we know that it is a notorious crime to kill
another, but it is a duty as anarchists to assassinate the
（印：SENIOR COMMISSIONER : MAY 13 1933 (CRIME BRANCH)）

报告 日期 1933年5月12日。
主题（全称） 暗杀阴谋
由梅本（D. S. Umemoto）撰写。由 O.Blu. D. 转呈。
遵照特别分部主管官员的指示，本人谨此报告，附剪报一份，系摘自1933年5月8日的《字林西报》，其中关于当地朝鲜不满分子策划在满洲暗杀满洲国及日本高官的消息毫无根据。
截至目前，当地日本领事馆警察未收到来自大连警方关于逮捕任何从上海前往该地的激进分子的消息。
继1933年3月17日工部局警务处逮捕三名朝鲜无政府主义者后，所有已知的朝鲜恐怖分子均已逃往不知去向，因此他们在上海的活动实际上已陷入停滞。
值得注意的是，在1933年3月17日被捕的三名朝鲜无政府主义者案件中，第二被告白求河（Haku Kyu Ha，音译）向当地日本领事馆警察一名官员所作的陈述中有如下摘录：-
“黑色恐怖党成员已达成一致，要抓住一切机会实施破坏工作。刺杀日本公使的计划由我们自行安排，并非受他人煽动。如果我们有足够的资金出国，可能会犯下更严重的罪行。我们因缺乏资金而未能实施这些行动，深感遗憾。我们选择日本驻华公使有吉明先生（Mr. Ariyoshi）作为目标，是因为他在上海，实施阴谋的费用较低。我们对公使个人并无怨恨，对暗杀他感到遗憾，我们也知道杀人是一项臭名昭著的罪行，但作为无政府主义者，暗杀
（印：高级警务专员：1933年5月13日（刑事部））
（批注：D.H.C. #6）

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, MONDAY, MAY, 8, 1933

Assassination Plot
DAIRIEN, May 7.—Korean mal-
contents at Shanghai are being
incited by "certain quarters" to
attempt the assassination of lead-
ing Manchoukuo and Japanese
officials in Manchuria, according
to a report appearing in a local
Japanese newspaper.
Some of the would-be assassins,
says the paper, have been arrest-
ed by the Dairen police on their
arrival here from Shanghai.
Among the alleged intended
victims cited by the newspaper
are Mr. Henry Pu Yi, Chief Ex-
ecutive of Manchoukuo, and Field
Marshal Muto, Japanese Ambas-
sador at Changchun.
The same report adds that
special precautions are being taken
to safeguard the lives of the party
of Japanese notables at present
touring Manchuria, among whom
is the Marquis Kuni, younger bro-
ther of the Empress of Japan.—
Reuter.

《字林西报》，1933年5月8日，星期一

暗杀阴谋
大连，5月7日电。——据当地一家日文报纸报道，上海的朝鲜不满分子正受到“某些方面”的煽动，企图在满洲暗杀满洲国及日本的高级官员。
该报称，一些企图行刺者在从上海抵达此地时已被大连警方逮捕。
该报列举的所谓预定受害者包括满洲国行政长官溥仪先生（Mr. Henry Pu Yi）以及驻长春的日本大使武藤元帅（Field Marshal Muto）。
同一报道还补充说，目前正在满洲巡视的日本显贵一行人的生命安全正受到特别保护，其中包括日本皇后的弟弟邦彦王侯爵（Marquis Kuni）。——路透社。
